syllabus_topics: Elements of network architecture: topology, OSI model, transport media (cables, optical fiber)
Low network layers: Ethernet and 802.3 standards
IP and its environment: addressing, addressing plans. Routing
Layer 2 and Layer 3 interaction: ARP TCP: state machine. Address translation
Practical work: IP: configuration and services in a Linux environment
Addressing, routing, NAT: Services: DHCP, telnet, SSH, FTP, Web: Configuration and uses
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
